evidence.point: The client has 4 counters, which is the primary driver of the risk score (SHAP rank 1).
The client has a high volume of 80 invoices, which is a significant contributor to the risk model (SHAP rank 2).
Consumption data shows high irregularity, with skewness at 3.7915 (96.6th percentile) and kurtosis at 20.3714 (97.3rd percentile).
The client record indicates the presence of missing months, which may impact billing accuracy.
